within_arm_selection: Minimum weighted validation loss over epochs zero and one; same initialization and fresh Adam per arm/seed. One-epoch bounded warm-start screen, not convergence.
family_selection: Validation only. Both seeds must satisfy safety gates versus matched augmentation-off control AND B.2 anchor: empty false positives <= reference+1, missed occupied <= reference+1, overall correct >= reference-2, each black rook/king/queen correct >= reference-1, each orientation occupied correct >= reference-1, exact boards >= reference. Occupied accuracy must not regress in either seed versus matched control and its mean gain must be >=0.01. Rank eligible families by mean validation macro F1, then mean occupied accuracy. If none qualifies retain B.2. Representative seed fixed to 42; no best-seed or test selection.
occlusion: Deferred: ground-square masks are not verified piece silhouettes; no current visibility reviews guarantee label-preserving partial erasure.
combination: No combined augmentation arm in this bounded separate-family screen; do not combine without individual evidence and a further matched experiment.
holdout: Existing historical prepared splits only, already inspected development evidence; final A.3 holdout unopened. Unknown historical session provenance remains a limitation.
